## Basic Word Animation

Text animates word by word with a single click:

[Hello beautiful world]{.fragment .words .bounceIn}

[Welcome to RevealJS slides]{.fragment .words .fadeIn}

## Basic Usage

```markdown
[Hello beautiful world]{.fragment .words .bounceIn}

[Welcome to RevealJS slides]{.fragment .words .fadeIn}
```

Use `.fragment .words` with any animation class.

## Word Animation Speeds

Control the stagger delay between words (reuses the `letter-*` speed classes
with word-appropriate timings):

[Faster (60ms)]{.fragment .words .fadeIn .letter-faster}

[Fast (100ms)]{.fragment .words .fadeIn .letter-fast}

[Default (150ms)]{.fragment .words .fadeIn}

[Slow (250ms)]{.fragment .words .fadeIn .letter-slow}

[Slower (400ms)]{.fragment .words .fadeIn .letter-slower}

## Speed Classes

| Class | Delay |
|-------|-------|
| `letter-faster` | 60ms |
| `letter-fast` | 100ms |
| (default) | 150ms |
| `letter-slow` | 250ms |
| `letter-slower` | 400ms |

## Different Animation Styles

Various animations work with words:

[Bounce in here]{.fragment .words .bounceIn}

[Zoom into focus]{.fragment .words .zoomIn}

[Slide from the left]{.fragment .words .slideInLeft}

[Rotate into place]{.fragment .words .rotateIn}

# Header Animation {.fragment .words .bounceIn}

Word-by-word works on headers too!

## Header Syntax

```markdown
# Title goes here {.fragment .words .bounceIn}

## Section header text {.fragment .words .zoomIn .letter-fast}
```
